selectedDescriptions./api/v2/tokens/{mint}/rewards: Lifetime holder-reward totals of a reward coin. The body is {mint, mode, quote, basis, rewards, base, generatedAt}. rewards holds quote-token amounts. base holds what the launch paid in its own token, and is null when it never did. A standard launch gives mode: "standard" with null rewards. basis is "ledger" or "snapshot", the source of the totals. basis: "awaiting-snapshot" means the totals are not built yet, and rewards is null: try again in one minute. The figures that change on each payout are on /tokens/{mint}/rewards/pending. walletsPaid counts the distinct wallets ever paid in that asset. Fee recipient payouts are not in these totals: see /tokens/{mint}/rewards/fee-recipients. Each *Raw field is an integer string. Each *Tokens field is null when the decimals are not known.
selectedDescriptions./api/v2/tokens/{mint}/rewards/holders: Lifetime totals of what the holders of a reward coin were paid. The body is {mint, mode, quote, basis, rewards, base, generatedAt}. These are the /tokens/{mint}/rewards totals, which do not include fee recipient payouts. rewards is {distributedRaw, distributedTokens, payoutCount} in the quote token. base is the same in the launch token with an asset field, and is null when no holder was paid in it. mode has the same meaning as on /tokens/{mint}/rewards. basis is "ledger". basis: "awaiting-ledger" means the totals are not built yet, and rewards is null: try again in one minute. Each *Raw field is an integer string. Each *Tokens field is null when the decimals are not known.
selectedDescriptions./api/v2/rewards/launches: One page of lifetime reward totals, one row for each launch and the asset it paid. The body is {asset, sort, basis, rows, page}. Each row is {mint, asset, distributedRaw, distributedTokens, payoutCount, walletsPaid, lastPayoutAt}. asset is {mint, symbol, decimals}. walletsPaid counts the distinct wallets ever paid in that asset. sort=distributed orders by distributedTokens and leaves out rows whose decimals are not known. Amounts in different assets are compared as token counts, not by value. sort=recent orders by lastPayoutAt. Totals include payouts up to about one minute old. basis: "awaiting-backfill" means the totals are not built yet, and rows is empty.

documentation.rateLimitExcerpt: Rate limits # Every response carries X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset . A 429 adds Retry-After ; honour it. Endpoints Per minute Why Every /api/public/v1 endpoint except the two prepares 300 Reads, both submits, status POST /launches/prepare 25 Launch quotes POST /tokens/{mint}/fees/claim/prepare 20 Claim quotes /api/v2 /revenue/summary, /platform-token/split 30 Whole-history aggregates Every other /api/v2 endpoint 240 v2 reads Limits are per IP address and per minute, and that table is the whole story: there are no paid tiers above it. Read responses are CDN-cached, and a cache hit never reaches our servers, so it costs you nothing against these numbers. Building something that needs more headroom? Get in touch.
